paragraphs.text: The Meteor Hammer spell was a spell used by Tetsuo Umezawa to destroy the Imperial Shrine and thus rob Nicol Bolas of the mana base he needed to manifest in Dominaria .

Tetsuo was taught this spell by Kolo Meha . The spell made the warhammer of Jorgan Hage fly into the sky until it reached the edge of the atmosphere, from where it plummeted like a meteor on Tetsuo's command. The spell was instrumental in the destruction of Nicol Bolas and the liberation of the Madaran Empire from his tyrannical rule.
